## Summary / 修改说明

Describe the problem and the focused solution.

请说明问题和本次范围清晰的解决方案。

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] Relevant unit tests were added or updated / 已新增或更新相关单元测试
- [ ] `make docker-verify` passes / `make docker-verify` 已通过
- [ ] `make e2e` passes when integration behavior changed / 涉及联动行为时 `make e2e` 已通过
- [ ] Public behavior and compatibility impact are documented / 已说明公共行为和兼容性影响
- [ ] No secrets, private keys, generated output, or unrelated changes are included / 不包含密钥、私钥、构建产物或无关修改
